content.comment_body: Hello, I am using Windows 8.1 Pro 64-bit. I currently have [product_name] V7.0.30 and want to update to [product_name] V7.1.5. I tried online updates but it didn't work. Could you provide the correct [url] for this update? Thank you.

You can download the upgrade to [product_name] V8 from this site: [url]. Make sure to run setup.exe as administrator. Edit: It is not possible to update to V7.1.5 on the [company_name] website, only upgrading to V8 can be done.
In my old [product_name] V7 folder, there is an 'updateTemp' folder containing an update file for V7.1.15 (Win 64-bit). Are you interested in this?
Time has passed... But if you're still interested, let me know.
Do you have a genuine question or are you posting spam?
This is not spam. I truly need this update.
The update to [product_name] V7.1.5 is no longer available. You can only upgrade to the latest version, which is currently V8.2.1.
Thank you. Unfortunately, this version does not support the language I require. Apologies for any inconvenience.
Which language file do you need and for which [product_name] version?
[product_name] V8.2.1 does not support Russian. Could you share the contact address for questions regarding the interface of [product_name] V8.2.1?
You should submit a support request.

[company_name] only provides upgrades to the most recent version of [product_name] (currently V8.2.1) online. The DVD option also only includes the latest version. Since the newest version is compatible with previous [product_name] releases, this is usually sufficient.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble updating [product_name] to specific older versions like V7.1.5 since these updates are no longer accessible. The only update officially offered is to the current version, but some users face limitations such as missing language support (e.g., Russian), which affects usability for non-English speakers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the flexibility to update [product_name] to any intermediate version and retain features like native language support.
